name: cinavault-premium
description: CinaVault Premium — A full-featured Media Server

scripts.rust:check:windows: npm run prepare:wireguard:windows && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.tauri:build:windows: npm run prepare:wireguard:windows && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.tauri:build:ms-v1:windows: npm run prepare:wireguard:windows && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.msv1.conf.json --features store-safe --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.verify:preflight: npm run verify:master-build && npm run verify:contracts && npm run scan:preventive
scripts.test: npm run verify:preflight && node --test tests/carryForwardVerification.test.mjs tests/build170RemoteConnectivity.test.mjs tests/v2Build102UiStability.test.mjs tests/v2Build103CommandPaletteStability.test.mjs tests/platformParityContract.test.mjs tests/hlsStreamSupport.test.mjs tests/build140GoogleCast.test.mjs tests/storeSafeEdition.test.mjs && npm run test:remote-user
scripts.test:all: npm run verify:preflight && node --test tests/carryForwardVerification.test.mjs tests/build170RemoteConnectivity.test.mjs tests/v2Build102UiStability.test.mjs tests/v2Build103CommandPaletteStability.test.mjs tests/platformParityContract.test.mjs tests/hlsStreamSupport.test.mjs tests/build140GoogleCast.test.mjs tests/storeSafeEdition.test.mjs && npm run test:remote-user
